quality.review_scope: Complete local 10-page main paper and 5-page SI. Proposed final status gated on exact independent scoped acceptance.
missing_fields: Exact physical-batch joins between growth series, phase transfer, optical and microscopy specimens are not established. Related procedures do not assert a common aliquot.
Unreported reactor capacity, shaking/stirring speeds, gas flow/pressure, workup volumes and durations, stock concentrations, purified-QD concentrations, isolated yields and storage remain missing.
No atomic coordinates, measured particle facets, surface coverage or explicit crystal structure model is supplied. Lattice-plane indexing is not a particle-facet assignment.
Original curves are retained without digitizing unprinted peak positions or intensities.
The pH-series caption states 30 min growth and text states initial growth pH 9; exact precursor concentrations and per-sample pH-adjustment/TCEP quantities are not supplied.
conflicts: Figure 4 caption describes panel (a) as UV–vis absorption, whereas its plotted axis and Without TCEP label show emission. The visible emission context is retained with the caption discrepancy.
